children: Germany's 2027 renewable energy act provides stronger demand visibility in Nordex's key home market in the midterm, Citi analysts write. The act--known as EEG 2027--is due to become effective on Jan. 1 after the Federal cabinet adopted the draft proposal over the summer. "We already saw a strong 2027-28 for Nordex's earnings as likely given Nordex's order backlog and visibility from auctions," the analysts say. Support is now expected to extend into 2029, they add. Citi raises its rating on the stock to buy from neutral and the target price to 50 euros from 48 euros. Shares are up 1.7% at 41.10 euros and are 41% higher over the year to date.(ian.walker@wsj.com)
